_comment: Environment adapter: Dynamic Candles and Put Out The Fires. Each defines a fire and a frost keyword and
gives them to spells by name through KID; its scripts light or put out candles and fires when a spell
carrying one hits (and also read OnMagicEffectApply on the effect). These "damage" lines give the
keyword to the spell's fire damage effects (DC_Fire, POF_Fire) and to its frost, water or air damage
effects (DC_Frost, POF_Frost - the putting-out keyword), like env-elements.json
(docs/librarian/PERK_ADAPTERS.md 6-5). keywordForm ids read from DynamicCandles.esp and
perkMod: Dynamic Candles, Put Out The Fires

adapters.why: Put Out The Fires: light fires
Put Out The Fires: put fires out
